method: KEYFRAME-FIRST: refs, then a free Nano Banana still per beat, then Frames to Video on Veo 3.1 Lite from each still. Motion + sound prompts only.
cast: two friends, a man and a woman, late 20s
setting_basis: A narrow food lane in Ahmedabad's walled old city near Teen Darwaza at night: old two- and three-storey houses with carved wooden balconies and shutters, small open-fronted eateries with clay tandoors set into their counters, steel pots, bare bulbs on wires, a wet stone lane. No mall, no market square, no readable signboards. The footage shows no real eatery's name or interior and makes no time, price or history claim of its own; those are the script's.
look: Soft natural light, natural colour, anamorphic 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, soft film grain, photorealistic, cinematic. Faces are never in close-up and no one looks at the camera. A phone screen is only a soft glow, never legible. No other people. No music, no speech, no voiceover, no text, captions, logos or watermark.

en: The tandoors were still cold when my friend Tanvi and I reached the lane.
She was hungry, so she turned back toward Teen Darwaja to eat anywhere else.
Then I read the NakshIQ note I'd skipped: don't walk in before nine.
We waited on wet stones until the first tandoor caught with a low roar.

Over tava biryani and chicken angara, Tanvi, who had wanted to leave, asked for seconds.
Their families have cooked here since they fed the sultan who founded this city.

This is Bhatiyar Gali, and the city is Ahmedabad.
Travel intelligence is knowing when a place wakes up.
NakshIQ.
hi: जब मैं और मेरी दोस्त तन्वी उस गली में पहुँचे, तो तंदूर अभी ठंडे पड़े थे।
उसे भूख लगी थी, तो वो कहीं और खाने के लिए तीन दरवाज़ा की तरफ़ वापस मुड़ गई।
फिर मैंने NakshIQ का वो नोट पढ़ा जो छोड़ दिया था: नौ बजे से पहले मत आना।
हम गीले पत्थरों पर रुके रहे, जब तक पहला तंदूर भक से जल नहीं उठा।

तवा बिरयानी और चिकन अंगारा आया, और जो तन्वी वापस जाना चाहती थी, उसी ने दोबारा मँगाया।
इनके परिवार तब से यहाँ खाना बना रहे हैं, जब इन्होंने इस शहर को बसाने वाले सुल्तान को खिलाया था।

ये है भटियार गली, और शहर है अहमदाबाद।
ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस है ये जानना कि कोई जगह कब जागती है।
NakshIQ.
